description: Example AlignedDataCtrlr instance giving a secondary OCPP connection clock-aligned meter values of its own, as described in the OCA application note 'Secondary OCPP Connection on a Charging Station' section 4.5.1. Typically a much higher sampling rate than is practical towards the CSMS. Needed only for that; a connection granted MeterValues in UpstreamMsgs receives copies of the charging station's own meter values without it. The instance name must match the OCPPCommCtrlr instance that declares the connection.
name: AlignedDataCtrlr

Interval.description: How often, in seconds, this connection is sent clock-aligned meter values of its own. Zero, the default, means none. These are sent whether or not a transaction is running, and are additional to any TransactionEvent copies the connection receives.

Measurands.description: The measurands this connection's own clock-aligned meter values carry. Nothing is sent if this is absent.
